Fifth Sunday in Ordinary Time September 20 2026 This weekend September 19th 20th the Church celebrates the Twenty fifth Sunday in Ordinary Time Our readings confront our instinct to measure Gods generosity by our own bookkeeping Yet God's grace refuses to be treated as an earned wage It is instead a gift given freely by God As we see in our readings this is truly for the best as Gods thoughts and ways are higher than ours as we still struggle to understand grace and put aside envy 40th Annual Bishop's Appeal Starting this past week every registered parish household has or will have received a letter from Bishop Rhoades to kick off the 40th Annual Bishop's Appeal This year's theme United in Mission highlights how we are united in our mission to spread the fire of God's love the Gospel of Jesus Christ in our diocese This includes through our charitable outreach which extends beyond our own parish and aids those both near and far This annual diocesan appeal helps to fund various ministries and outreaches throughout the fourteen counties that make up our diocese including support of parishes seminarian education and Catholic Charities Our 40th Annual Bishop's Appeal Goal this year is 3741464 All donations above our parish goal will be returned directly to our parish To learn more about the ap peal or to make a donation online visit wwwdiocesefwsborgaba Beatification of Ven Fulton Sheen On Thursday Sept 24th Venerable Fulton Sheen will be beatified at a special Mass in St Louis Missouri The Mass itself will take place in the Dome at Americas Center the former stadium for the St Louis Rams and is expected to have over 80000 faithful in attendance Sheen was often referred to as America's Bishop due to the great popularity of his radio and television personality as he hosted Life is Worth Living In the back of church we have cards to commemorate this special occasion with a prayer seeking the intercession of Blessed Fulton Sheen Addressed to God the Father through Jesus Christ and in the power of the Holy Spirit the prayer praises God as the source of every blessing It then gives thanks for the witness of Bl Sheen's earthly life and asks that he may continue to glorify God in heaven by joining his prayers to ours for our particular intentions Forty Days for Life Display In anticipation of the start of the annual Forty Days for Life Campaign on Wednesday Sept 23rd our Knights of Columbus set up our parish's annual display This display serves as a visual reminder of our continued need to support and pray for the unborn and all those affected by abortion in Wells County uniting in a special way with many groups over these next forty days Parish Renovation Update The End is Nigh On Monday our Shawnee team will be removing the dust screen hanging from the ceiling This means that the majority of painting spraying and cutting that can create dust is completed As there is still some electrical and millwork to be completed in the sanctuary our red curtains will remain until we have full use of the sanctuary the weekend of our parish picnic on Oct 4th After so many delays we are excited to soon be back in our sanctuary Stuff the Truck St Vincent de Paul Society The weekend of our Parish Picnic October 3rd 4th we will be partnering with the St Vincent de Paul Society of Decatur for a Stuff the Truck event This event helps to support the St Vincent de Paul Thrift Store Ministry of our neighboring parish St Mary of the Assumption in nearby Decatur to provide clothing and furniture for those in need
